narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced heavy rain across the east side of Tallahassee. Rainfall amounts of 2-3 inches occurred in 1 hour.
ev: Significant ponding of water occurred in the southbound lanes of Capital Circle Southeast at Midyette Road. Radar estimated 2.65 inches of rain occurred in 1 hour at this location.
lsr: PONDING OF WATER ON SOUTHBOUND LANES OF CAPITAL CIRCLE SOUTHEAST AT MIDYETTE ROAD. KNOWN AREA PRONE TO FLOODING. RADAR ESTIMATED 2.65 INCHES OF RAIN IN 1 HOUR AT THIS LOCATION.
